cohort.assessment: First integration candidate. Existing evidence: 308920 rows; 308 null gtm_ind_fiscal; 308612 distinct nonnull values across the layer. Bounded samples showed distinct fiscal IDs. Offset pagination repeats rows, but ArcGIS supports ID manifests and an explicit nonnull filter can scope to identified rows. Reuse permission for this exact layer remains unresolved.

Do not integrate yet. CC BY 4.0, but cod_lote duplicates within one bounded sample and OBJECTID_12 is a system-maintained row identity. No documented durable native parcel key; 50-row adapter bbox previously timed out.

Strong first integration candidate after fresh verification. Both the previous layer 3 and a separate finance layer 1 returned identical 58-row samples and passed the same 18-cell gate using DSQFL object-ID manifests, native exact reads, and disjoint-parts checks. Four DSQFL IDs had multiple nonoverlapping components; no null DSQFL occurred in the tested grid.

descriptorSuggestion.scope: Official Recife Lotes polygons with nonnull DSQFL; other records outside identified scope are excluded. This is municipal coverage only; national or regional coverage is not inferred.
descriptorSuggestion.name: Recife identified lot polygons

candidates.identitySemantics: DSQFL is the published district/sector/block/face/lot string key. Preserve as text, including leading zeroes. The prior Recife layer 3 result using this key had duplicate geometries in three cells. In the new full 18-cell recheck, each repeated-key group consisted of disjoint components; the adapter merged them and exact native-ID reads matched. Two rows in the small center sample lacked valid SEQIMOVEL, but DSQFL was present for all tested rows.

descriptorSuggestion.scope: Curitiba mapped lots with nonnull municipal Indicação Fiscal; city-published technical cadastral base, not the legal land registry.

candidates.identitySemantics: Indicação Fiscal is the municipal property/cadastral identifier displayed and searched by the official Mapa Cadastral. Preserve as text; earlier aggregate showed nonnull values unique, but the layer does not declare a unique index. It can describe a tax sublot/unit, so root full gate must verify same-key geometries and determine intended scope. Null-key rows are deliberately outside the identified scope if filtered.
candidates.reuseGate: Exact layer metadata and itemInfo have empty license/copyright fields. Prior assessment found no reuse grant specific to this layer. Obtain written permission or applicable explicit license before persistence/reuse; technical acceptance does not resolve this.

candidates.identitySemantics: Physical lots from 2013 aerial survey; current candidate cod_lote is not unique and OBJECTID_12 is explicitly system-maintained, so no semantic native ID is established. A composite identity/parts strategy needs publisher documentation and full duplicate geometry analysis; do not use OID as parcel identity.

recifeLiveGate.method: Repository createArcgisParcelSource with boundsQueryMode=object-ids, idsQueryMode=object-ids, nativeGeometryMode=parts, disjointParts=true, partsCoordinatePrecision=9, attributeNotNull=[DSQFL]. Same 3x3 grid of 0.0025-degree cells at WUP Recife center and grid shifted +0.004 degrees lon/lat; exact reads for all retained native IDs in batches of at most 80. Geometry was held in memory only and is not saved in this file.

recifeLiveGate.comparison: Both layers returned identical metadata shape, extent CRS, same 58-row sample, and same 18-cell aggregate behavior. Recommend previously investigated general Lotes FeatureServer/3; it has a 6000 row cap versus 2000 for the finance layer, while keeping the selected outFields identity-only.
